NOT A RETREAT RETREAT.

Think beautiful surroundings, thoughtful movement, really good food, creativity, a little adventure and plenty of time to enjoy yourself. No heavy life coaching. No wellness clichés. Just a very good edit of the things that make you feel like yourself again.

MEET ELIZABETH
YOGA · MOVEMENT · ART

Elizabeth Hartzell has spent more than 15 years exploring movement in all its forms—as a yoga instructor, professional dancer, personal trainer and lifelong student of the body. A Little Rock native with BFAs in painting and dance from UALR, she is a 200-hour Registered Yoga Teacher trained in Hatha, Ashtanga, Iyengar and Yin yoga. Her dance, biomechanics and athletic-performance background informs creative classes that help you feel strong and fluid.
